posts.meta_description:
khloekardashian on October 22, 2026: "Happy Happy Birthday to my Keeks!!! My sister, my best friend, my forever girl!

How lucky am I?  Of all the blessings God could have given me, having you as my sister will forever be one of my favorites.

We’ve experienced more together than most people could ever imagine. We’ve laughed until we couldn’t breathe, cried through things we never thought we’d get through, and somehow always found our way to the other side. There’s something so special about having someone who knows your entire story because they’ve been right there living it with you.

I hope you know how extraordinary you are, not because of what you’ve built or achieved, but because of the person you are when all of that is stripped away. The way you love, the way you care, and the way you make the impossible seem possible. You have such a beautiful way of leaving people and situations better than you found them.

More than anything, I hope this next year brings you the kind of happiness that doesn’t need an audience. The quiet moments, the unexpected laughter, the freedom to do absolutely nothing, and the peace of knowing you have nothing to prove to anyone. You deserve the life you live. A life that feels just as incredible on the inside as it looks on the outside.

No matter how much our worlds change, I love that we can still be two little girls laughing at things nobody else would understand. Some things are simply too special for time to touch.

I’m so proud of the woman you are, but even more grateful for the sister I get to call mine. Whatever life has waiting for us, I know we’ll find a way to make it memorable, probably a little chaotic, and definitely hilarious.

I’ll never stop being in your corner. Not because we’re sisters, but because there’s nowhere else I’d rather be

I love you more than you’ll ever know

You and me, Keeks. What a ride it’s been, and what a beautiful ride we still have ahead of us 🩵

PS
I know I’m a day late. I recorded a few podcasts yesterday. A girl was busy".
